Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE V OF 1971
ORDINANCE V OF 1971
PAKISTAN TOBACCO BOARD (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1971
1. Short title
and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan
Tobacco Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1971.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3 Ordinance I of 1968

ORDINANCE V OF 1971
ORDINANCE V OF 1971
PAKISTAN TOBACCO BOARD (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1971
2. Amendment of
section 3, Ordinance I of 1968.‑In the Pakistan Tobacco Board
Ordinance, 1968, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordi nance, in section 3,
in subsection (1),‑
(1) in clause (a),
for the words "each Province" the words "East Pakistan and
the other from . one of the other Provinces" shall be substituted
(2) for clause (b) the following shall be substituted,
namely :‑
" (b) six
members, two each from East Pakistan, the North‑West Frontier Province
and the Punjab, to be nominated by the Provincial Government concerned from
amongst the tobacco growers;" ;
(3) in clause (c), for the words "each
Province" the words "East Pakistan and the other from one of the
other Provinces" shall he substituted ;
(4) in clause (d), for the word "two" the
word "five" shall be substituted ;
(5) in clause (f ), for the
full‑stop at the end a semi‑colon shall be substituted ; and
(6) after clause( f )amended as
aforesaid, the following new clause shall be added, namely :‑
"(g) one member, being an
officer serving under the Central Govern ment in the Ministry of Agriculture
and Works (Food and Agriculture Division), to be nominated by the Central
Government."

Amendment of section 9 Ordinance I of 1968

ORDINANCE V OF 1971
ORDINANCE V OF 1971
PAKISTAN TOBACCO BOARD (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1971
3. Amendment of section 9, Ordinance
1 of 1968.‑In the said Ordinance, in section 9, after subsection (1),
the following new subsections shall be inserted, namely :‑
"(1‑A) The Central Government may, from
time to time by notification in the official Gazette, fix, for tile purpose of
levying cess under subsection (1), tariff values of tobacco produced in
Pakistan and may alter tariff values for the time being in force.
(1‑B) Different tariff
values may be fixed for different classes or descrip tions of tobacco."

Amendment of section 12 Ordinance I of 1968

ORDINANCE V OF 1971
ORDINANCE V OF 1971
PAKISTAN TOBACCO BOARD (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1971
4. Amendment of
section 12, Ordinance I of 1968.‑In the said Ordinance, in section
12, in subsection (1), for clauses (c) and (d)
the following shall be substituted, namely :‑
"(c) two members to be appointed by the Central
Government from amongst the persons nominated to the Board under clause (b) of sub section (I) of section 3, one
being from East Pakistan and the other from the North‑West Frontier
Province or the Punjab ;
(d) two
members to be appointed by the Central Government from amongst the persons
nominated to the Board under clause (d) of sub section (1) of section 3, one
being from East Pakistan and the other from one of the other Provinces."

Validation

ORDINANCE V OF 1971
ORDINANCE V OF 1971
PAKISTAN TOBACCO BOARD (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1971
5. Validation.‑Any order or notification fixing
the assessed value of tobacco at two rupees a pound and purporting to be issued
in exercise of a power given by the said Ordinance, and all cess purporting to
be levied and collected under the said Ordinance‑‑ on the basis of
the assessed value so fixed, shall be deemed to have been validly fixed, levied
and collected as if the Central Government bad power under the said Ordinance
to fix the assessed value of tobacco for the purpose of the levy of the cess
and to levy and collect the cess on the basis of the assessed value so fixed.
